A.notes: Three MessageBubbles in a ScrollArea with a bound Composer and send event; pinning relies on maxHeight rather than layout.

B.notes: Same bubbles and Composer, pinned via a hand-styled flex Box, slightly less idiomatic but equally complete.

A.notes: Complete address form with specific error messages, delivery radio, computed summary and seeded subtotal; radio labels omit the prices.

B.notes: Same structure with priced radio labels, but every check uses the generic 'Required check failed' message.

A.notes: All fields and checks present, but bare form with no data model or placeholders.

B.notes: Same fields and checks inside a titled Card with placeholders and an initialized data model.

A.notes: Header, three stat tiles and a data-bound orders table with caption, laid out flat.

B.notes: Same content with the table framed in a titled Card and a vertical Stack for spacing.

A.notes: Idiomatic EmptyState with folder icon, title, sentence and Create project action.

B.notes: Identical idiomatic EmptyState with a slightly different description.

A.notes: Breadcrumb, search and six-file table with a wired Rename/Delete row menu and navigation/search events.

B.notes: Table filters by the search query, but the row action menu and breadcrumb fire no events.

B.notes: Uses the Page header slot for the action, but likewise shows the unread badge on every item.

A.notes: Three Sections with counts and tints holding card-surface Rows with avatars; counts hardcoded.

B.notes: Same requirements in a welcoming Card with placeholders and the link grouped with the form.

A.notes: Cover, title, artist, progress, prev/play-pause/next with toggling state, and a four-track queue.

A.notes: Billing toggle, three titled Cards with prices reacting to billing, checked feature Lists and a highlighted recommended Pro card.

A.notes: Search field and responsive grid of four templated product cards with image, name, price, rating and add-to-cart.

B.notes: Same content with product ids, an image fallback and a spaced Stack inside each Card.

A.notes: Prefilled form with avatar and Change photo, all fields, timezone select and Save/Cancel.

B.notes: Same prefilled form plus sensible required/email validation.
